I would say this is not possible. I previously got the bonus using sole prop/SSN in June 2025. Just this morning I tried opening an account for sole prop/EIN as well as LLC/EIN and both were met with the “You’re not eligible for this bonus” page at the end of the application. I did not use my previous login for either one.

The IRS will only assign you one EIN as a sole proprietor per person. Per the SS-4 instructions:
Generally, a sole proprietor should file only one Form SS-4 and needs only one EIN, regardless of the number of businesses operated as a sole proprietorship or trade names under which a business operates.

In practice, the automated online application will block assigning a second sole prop EIN, and agents are supposed to search to see if you already have a sole prop EIN before manually assigning one.

A sole prop can be assigned an EIN and you can have multiple sole props. So I will be creating multiple entities for both myself and P2 and since I have confirmed Mercury will pay the bonus so long as the tax ID is different.
